$comment: Component inventory — Pujan Banik Arnab portfolio (Astro). Machine-readable companion to design.md §6. jsBytes = client-side JS shipped by the component (Astro is static-first).

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 (@tailwindcss/vite, no preflight) bridged via @theme inline onto generated M3 role tokens; scoped token-driven CSS for pseudo-element machinery
stack.clientJs: minimal, vanilla, transform/opacity only; JS-driven reveal orchestration + ambient hero wave (no reduced-motion suppression, v0.7.0 policy)

backgroundSystem.name: exact-reference hero dots (hero-only rule)

canvas.carrier: html (opaque #ECECEC light / #1E1E1E dark — exact theretriever.app body backgrounds)
canvas.note: opaque body background would hide the z-index:0 hero wave (known bug class; verify-design-contract.mjs guards)

application.scope: hero ONLY — no other dotted surface allowed
application.pattern: animated canvas dot wave painted by public/wave.js (byte-exact reference port; v0.7.0: upstream reduced-motion still-frame branch patched out per owner motion policy — pristine copy + provenance in docs/reference-assets/)
application.attributes: data-speed 0.5, data-alpha 1.6, data-size 1.6, 48x26 grid (dotwave token group, injected from design-tokens.json at build time)
application.mask: dual linear-gradient mask composited with intersect (--dotwave-mask-x/y)
application.source: live headless-Chrome forensics of theretriever.app hero (2026-10-22, tool-results/ref-forensics/)

nonDotVisualLanguage: About states: verified decay-1/2/3.svg dot-matrix illustrations as content figures (byte-exact reuse, provenance md5s)
Experience zones: solid ink fill + tertiary hatch + void
brand mark: unit box in frame (rect only, zero circles)
guards: hero canvas: pointer-events none, IntersectionObserver-gated paint, DPR-aware
hero is the ONLY dotted surface (contract D3: no radial-gradient circles, no extra canvas.wave)

components.name: Hero
features: section carries the hero-only exact dot pattern via global.css .hero::before
stage panel = flat reference card (container-lowest + outline-variant hairline + 12px radius), no sonar
app window with pulse grid (in-window UI, dark chrome)

components.name: Scene

components.name: Heading
components.notes: M3 headline-large; explicit line blocks for viewport-stable rhythm

components.name: PrinciplesBlock

components.name: ContactScene

components.name: AppWindow
